records.baseline_answer:
No, Apollo 9's crew did not fly the Lunar Module to the Moon's surface. Apollo 9 was an Earth-orbit mission focused on testing the Lunar Module in space, including its engines and docking capabilities, but it did not travel to the Moon. The first mission to land on the Moon was Apollo 11.

Apollo 9 was primarily a test of the full Apollo spacecraft stack in Earth orbit. During this mission, McDivitt and Schweickart flew the Lunar Module independently of the Command Module but only in Earth orbit ([apollo_9::0], [apollo_9::3]).
records.pipeline_answer: No, Apollo 9's crew was not the first to fly the Lunar Module to the Moon's surface. Apollo 9 was an Earth-orbit mission that carried out the first crewed test flight of the Lunar Module but did not go to the Moon. The first mission to land a Lunar Module on the Moon's surface was Apollo 11.
